title: Grid lines support reading
summary: A light grid can help readers estimate values. It should support the data rather than overpower it.
introduction: A light grid can help readers estimate values. It should support the data rather than overpower it. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A light grid can help readers estimate values. It should support the data rather than overpower it.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2, 3], [2, 4, 3])
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
blocks.title: Grid lines support reading

blocks.text: The grid is partly transparent, so the plotted line remains easy to see.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Too many heavy lines make a chart harder to read.
